# Laya Excel Insights

Turns your spreadsheet data into clear insight: summary tables, simple charts and five plain-English findings with the numbers behind them - ready for your manager, a meeting or a report. Get an Excel workbook with charts, a short Word summary, or both.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

The spreadsheet with your data.

## What you get

Five plain-English findings, an Excel workbook with summary tables and charts, and (if you want) a short Word summary.

## Example

"What does our complaints log tell us for Q3?" The agent proposes questions (volume by month, top categories, time to resolve), you pick, and you get charts with titles like 'Complaints fell 9% in September'.

## Try saying

- *What are the main things this data tells us?*
- *Can you show me the monthly trend in this data, with a chart?*
- *Which categories are biggest and smallest in this data?*

## Tips

- Say who it's for - your manager, a team meeting or a steering group - and the agent pitches it right.
- If the data is messy, clean it with the Laya Excel Data Cleaner first.
